name: Garagoa (Colombia)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and blue, the white charged with the municipal arms of Garagoa (a tree on white with the motto SULTANA DEL VALLE DE TENZA).
history: Municipal flag of Garagoa, a municipality in the department of Boyacá, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: Garagoa arms — tree on white with the motto SULTANA DEL VALLE DE TENZA
